sections.name: Hero Section
sections.title: The people who make the visit easy

paras.t: Three of us. You will know all of our names by your second visit.
Casey Morgan, D.C.
Owner and Chiropractor
Second-generation Austin chiropractor. Dr. Morgan decided on this at sixteen, watching his dad do it. Parker University graduate, Board Certified by the NBCE. He has led West End since 2016.
He does the exam, the imaging, and the adjusting himself. Every patient, every visit.
Tai Le
Chiropractic Assistant

Tai has been with West End since 2017, which makes him the person who has been here longest besides Dr. Morgan. He grew up in small-town Texas, moved to Austin in 2013, and graduated from UT Austin with a degree in Kinesiology and Health Education.
He plays tennis and is genuinely interested in getting patients back to whatever they were doing before the pain started.
If you call the office, there is a good chance you are talking to Tai.
Gabriella “Gabby” Menendez
Chiropractic Assistant
Gabby is originally from Cuba and grew up in New Orleans, where she worked as a chiropractic assistant before moving to Austin at the end of 2025. She fell for the city fast.
Her background in patient care shows up in how comfortable people are the moment they walk in. She says working here feels like being at home.
Outside the office: reading, movies, and anything involving capybaras. Her favorite color is yellow.

sections.title: Patients who came in hurting. Now they don't

paras.t: Your first visit covers your exam, a consultation, and any necessary digital X-rays. You will leave knowing what is going on.
1611 W. 5th St., just off MoPac. Free covered garage parking. Monday through Thursday.
